title: The Low Tide Landing Contradiction
description:
Witness A: 'I docked my deep-draft schooner at the high-water pier at 3:00 PM.'
Harbor Tide Table: 3:00 PM was the lowest ebb tide of the year (pier was completely dry mud).
question: Which witness is lying?
acceptable_answer_format:
Type only the witness name.

Example:
Witness A
hints: Deep draft ships cannot dock at dry mud low tide.
solution_explanation: A deep-draft schooner cannot dock at a pier surrounded by dry mud during the lowest ebb tide of the year. Witness A lied.
